Il segretariato della clinica ortopedica assicura una pratica regolare per circa 22 medici e medici assistenti. Per completare il nostro team di cliniche ortopediche, stiamo cercando una clinica ortopedica entro il 1 agosto 2026 o su appuntamento. Lo fanno con noi.
• Lei svolge in modo indipendente e tempestivo le attività organizzative e amministrative versatili, così come il coordinamento di pianificazione e nomina del medico principale.
• Guidano e guidano il team del segretariato e sono responsabili per la pianificazione e l'organizzazione dell'intera ora di consultazione ortopedica, ma anche per la pianificazione delle vacanze e il report dei dipendenti.
• Si occupano della corrispondenza medica del medico principale e assicurano la procedura liscia per l'ammissione e l'uscita di medici e sub-assisti.
• Sei una persona di contatto competente per i pazienti, gli arbitri e altri partner interni ed esterni. Ecco cosa portano con loro.
• Sei un'iniziativa, personalità indipendente e flessibile con l'istruzione e l'esperienza in una posizione paragonabile, che ama guidare un team con un sacco di abilità e competenze sociali.
• Si vedono come fornitori di servizi per posizioni interne ed esterne e sono abituati a svolgere e delegare compiti di gestione.
• Sei ben diversificato nell'utilizzo di Windows Office e hai competenze KISIM e SAP. Lavorare con noi

descriptionByLocale.en:
The secretariat of the Orthopaedic Clinic ensures a smooth practice for around 22 doctors and assistant doctors. To complement our orthopaedic clinic team, we are looking for an orthopaedic clinic by 1 August 2026 or by appointment. They do it with us.
• You independently and promptly carry out the versatile organizational and administrative activities, as well as the planning and appointment coordination of the chief physician.
• They lead and lead the team of the secretariat and are responsible for the planning and organization of the entire orthopaedic consultation hour but also for the holiday planning and time reporting of the employees.
• They handle the medical correspondence of the chief physician and ensure the smooth procedure for admission and exit of assistant doctors and sub-assistants.
• You are a competent contact person for patients, referees and other internal and external partners. This is what they bring with them.
• You are an initiative, independent and flexible personality with education and experience in a comparable position, who likes to lead a team with a lot of skill and social skills.
• They see themselves as service providers for internal and external positions and are accustomed to taking on and delegating management tasks.
• You are well-versed in using Windows Office and have KISIM and SAP skills. Working with us
• A varied and demanding area of responsibility with close contact to internal and external bodies
• An experienced and collegial team
• A working environment in which you can contribute your professional and human qualities
• Modern working conditions and contemporary employment conditions according to GAV SRO AG Spital Langenthal, St. Urbanstrasse 67, CH-4900 Langenthal T 062 916 31 31, F 062 916 31 12, info@sro.ch, www.sro.ch Tasks:
• You independently and promptly carry out the versatile organizational and administrative activities, as well as the planning and appointment coordination of the chief physician.
• They lead and lead the team of the secretariat and are responsible for the planning and organization of the entire orthopaedic consultation hour but also for the holiday planning and time reporting of the employees.
• They handle the medical correspondence of the chief physician and ensure the smooth procedure for admission and exit of assistant doctors and sub-assistants.
• You are a competent contact person for patients, referees and other internal and external partners. Requirements
• You are an initiative, independent and flexible personality with education and experience in a comparable position, who likes to lead a team with a lot of skill and social skills.
• They see themselves as service providers for internal and external positions and are accustomed to taking on and delegating management tasks.
• You are well-versed in using Windows Office and have KISIM and SAP skills.

• Vous exécutez de façon indépendante et rapide les activités organisationnelles et administratives polyvalentes, ainsi que la planification et la coordination des nominations du médecin en chef.
